# Research Agent Skills

> 281 open-source Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for academic research by Kalaris Labs: research paper and thesis writing without AI slop, journal formatting (Nature, Science, Cell, IEEE, ACM, Elsevier, Springer LNCS, PLOS, APA 7, arXiv), literature and systematic reviews (PRISMA 2020), citation verification, and 100+ scientific databases and analysis packages. Install: `npx skills add KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills` (skills.sh CLI; add `--all` for every skill or `--skill <name>` for specific ones). Not published as an npm package.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/README.md): overview, installation for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot
- [Documentation guides](https://docs.kalarislabs.com/research-agent-skills): papers, theses, systematic reviews and installation
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/catalog/skills.json): every skill with category and description
- [Full skill index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/llms-full.txt): every skill with full description, tags and install command
- [Benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/benchmarks/README.md): how skills are evaluated

## research-writing

- [abstract-and-title](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/abstract-and-title/SKILL.md): Write and sharpen research paper titles, abstracts (structured and unstructured), keywords, highlights, significance statements, graphical-abstract text and lay summaries.
- [cover-letter-to-editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/cover-letter-to-editor/SKILL.md): Write journal submission cover letters, presubmission inquiries, transfer requests, and reviewer suggestion or exclusion lists that help a manuscript get past editorial triage.
- [dhdna-profiler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/dhdna-profiler/SKILL.md): Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text.
- [markdown-mermaid-writing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/markdown-mermaid-writing/SKILL.md): Writes scientific documents and documentation as markdown with embedded Mermaid diagrams as the canonical, git-diffable source format.
- [market-research-reports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/market-research-reports/SKILL.md): Build evidence-traceable market research reports and assumption-driven market sizing or forecast scenarios.
- [ml-paper-writing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/ml-paper-writing/SKILL.md): Write publication-ready ML/AI papers for NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, AAAI, COLM.
- [peer-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/peer-review/SKILL.md): Prepare evidence-bounded, constructive peer-review drafts and structured manuscript assessments.
- [rebuttal-and-response-to-reviewers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/rebuttal-and-response-to-reviewers/SKILL.md): Plan and write responses to peer review, including journal "response to reviewers" letters for revise-and-resubmit, conference rebuttals under strict length limits (OpenReview/ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, AC…
- [reproducibility-statement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/reproducibility-statement/SKILL.md): Prepare the reproducibility, transparency and open-science parts of a paper, including data and code availability statements, reproducibility checklists (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL Responsible NLP, Nat…
- [research-grants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/research-grants/SKILL.md): Guides writing of competitive research grant proposals for NSF, NIH, DOE, DARPA, and Taiwan NSTC.
- [scholar-evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/scholar-evaluation/SKILL.md): Provide qualitative-first, evidence-traceable developmental review of scholarly works and audit low-stakes research-assessment rubrics with optional local quality controls.
- [scientific-critical-thinking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/scientific-critical-thinking/SKILL.md): Evaluate scientific claims and evidence quality.
- [scientific-writing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/scientific-writing/SKILL.md): Draft, revise, and audit scientific manuscripts or reports with explicit evidence provenance, reporting-guideline coverage, authorship accountability, confidentiality controls, and local consistency…
- [systems-paper-writing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/systems-paper-writing/SKILL.md): Provides paragraph-level structural blueprints for 10-12 page systems papers targeting OSDI, SOSP, ASPLOS, NSDI, and EuroSys.
- [unslop-academic-writing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/unslop-academic-writing/SKILL.md): Remove AI slop from research writing so papers, theses, grant proposals, reviews and rebuttals read as written by a careful human expert.

## literature-review

- [exa-search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/exa-search/SKILL.md): Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content.
- [firecrawl-research-index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/firecrawl-research-index/SKILL.md): Query Firecrawl Research Index paper endpoints for topic discovery, source metadata, question-matched passages, and citation-neighbor expansion.
- [liteparse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/liteparse/SKILL.md): Local document and PDF parsing that returns spatial text with bounding boxes.
- [literature-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/literature-review/SKILL.md): Runs systematic literature reviews by searching PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, and Semantic Scholar (plus web search via parallel-cli), screening studies, extracting data, synthesizing themes, and verifying…

- [paper-lookup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/paper-lookup/SKILL.md): Search 18 scholarly APIs for papers, preprints, citations, open-access full text, repository records, and journal OA status, and return results with reproducible provenance.
- [paperclip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/paperclip/SKILL.md): Search and read full-text biomedical papers, FDA/PMDA/EMA regulatory documents, clinical trial registries, and UniProt/PDB/ChEMBL entries with the Paperclip CLI from GXL.

- [parallel-web](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/parallel-web/SKILL.md): Runs the parallel-cli tool for web workflows: web search, URL and PDF extraction, deep research reports, structured data enrichment of supplied rows, FindAll entity discovery, and recurring web monit…

- [experimental-design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/experimental-design/SKILL.md): Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable.
- [hypogenic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/hypogenic/SKILL.md): Plans and audits use of ChicagoHAI HypoGeniC/HypoRefine for LLM-assisted hypothesis generation from labeled text datasets.
- [hypothesis-generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/hypothesis-generation/SKILL.md): Formulate evidence-bounded scientific questions, candidate hypotheses, rival explanations, causal or associational claims, discriminating predictions, measurements, and preregistration-ready analysis…
- [iso-standards-readiness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/iso-standards-readiness/SKILL.md): Prepares and structurally reviews readiness evidence for ISO management-system and laboratory-competence standards - ISO 13485 medical device QMS, ISO 14971 device risk management, ISO/IEC 17025 test…
- [relsa-severity-assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/relsa-severity-assessment/SKILL.md): Multivariate severity assessment and humane endpoint prediction for laboratory animal studies using the RELSA (RELative Severity Assessment) score and ARIMA-based foRcast forecasting.
- [scientific-brainstorming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/scientific-brainstorming/SKILL.md): Facilitates evidence-aware scientific ideation with independent generation, structured discussion, explicit assumptions, transparent evaluation, adversarial review, and decision logs.
- [statistical-power](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/statistical-power/SKILL.md): Sample-size and statistical power calculations for planning studies.
- [uncertainty-and-units](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/uncertainty-and-units/SKILL.md): Track physical units and propagate measurement uncertainty in scientific calculations using pint and uncertainties.

- [exploratory-data-analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/exploratory-data-analysis/SKILL.md): Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files.
- [get-available-resources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/get-available-resources/SKILL.md): Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload.
- [hugging-science](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/hugging-science/SKILL.md): Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery…

- [networkx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/networkx/SKILL.md): Create, analyze, and visualize complex networks and graphs in Python with NetworkX.
- [optimize-for-gpu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/optimize-for-gpu/SKILL.md): GPU-accelerates scientific Python on NVIDIA hardware and verifies that the result is correct and faster.
- [polars](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/polars/SKILL.md): High-performance DataFrame library for Python ETL, analytics, and pandas migration.
- [pufferlib](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/pufferlib/SKILL.md): Version-aware guidance for PufferLib reinforcement-learning environments, vectorization, policies, PuffeRL training, evaluation, and safe checkpoint review.
- [pymc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/pymc/SKILL.md): Builds, fits, checks, and compares Bayesian models in Python with PyMC and ArviZ.
- [pymoo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/pymoo/SKILL.md): Solves single- and multi-objective optimization problems in Python with pymoo, using NSGA-II, NSGA-III, MOEA/D, SPEA2, RVEA, GA, DE and PSO.

- [statsmodels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/statsmodels/SKILL.md): Statistical models library for Python.
- [sympy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/sympy/SKILL.md): Use when you need exact symbolic math in Python — algebra, calculus, equation solving, symbolic linear algebra, or code generation via lambdify/LaTeX.

- [umap-learn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/umap-learn/SKILL.md): Reduces and embeds high-dimensional data with umap-learn (UMAP) in Python, including 2D/3D visualization, supervised and semi-supervised UMAP, DensMAP, AlignedUMAP, Parametric UMAP (Keras), transform…

- [zarr-python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KalarisLabs/research-agent-skills/main/skills/zarr-python/SKILL.md): Guides use of Zarr-Python 3 for storing chunked, compressed N-dimensional arrays and groups, with local, in-memory, ZIP, and fsspec-backed S3/GCS/HTTP stores, plus NumPy, Dask, and Xarray integration.

## knowledge-and-rag
